items.html: Thus, Aba has MA and BON, Ima has MA and BON, Yisrael Saba has MA and BON, and Tevuna has MA and BON. But Arich Anpin and Atik are not so; rather, the males took MA alone and the females BON alone, hence they are joined in one Partzuf. But in Aba and Ima, who are a separate male and female, it is necessary that each one have in it MA and BON, so that they would not separate completely. And this is the secret of “the son is in Hochma, and the wise one is in Bina.” And so it is likewise in ZON: ZA has VAK of BON and VAK of MA, and the Nukva has Malchut of MA and Malchut of BON. Thus, in ZA there is HG, which is MA and BON, and so too in the Nukva.
